routes.reviewNote: Independent direct Token-2022 issuer mint/burn, backed by rand rather than another chain's escrow. The issuer whitepaper sections 4.04/4.08/4.11 states mint only when reserve rand is received, burn on redemption and expansion using each chain's native token standard. Moore's October 1 report independently identifies this exact Solana mint at snapshot slot 443168748. Finalized identity snapshot slot 454891046 (blockhash CmkAxc1dMUfs2Uuszipv2Wfo8GDtVTJwBQU1ThPzX6Kc, blockTime 1791555521) confirms ZAR Universal/ZARU, 6 decimals and ordinary issuer mint authority 8USLqNrJ6WfUcTk2XUBYGRiMA2Mp2qh9AhsJZBEg5W62. No bridge/controller or canonical lock-and-release liability is present in this native issuance path; signing-policy independence remains unresolved.

Independent native issuer liability: the deployed ERC20F implementation provides onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE) mint() and onlyRole(BURNER_ROLE) burn(), not a canonical-token lock/release adapter. The existing complete role census identifies issuer EOA 0x29fc8c0e185f7d6cb85e232412db8e2a28f72cf1, with no bridge minter. Existing October 5 executable-runtime correspondence remains the source binding; October 9 pinned Ethereum block 26124902 additionally confirms ZARU, 18 decimals and implementation 0x0f25045d15c163478bb67c56c5d9d602628f4f62. Issuer fiat-backed native expansion is documented in whitepaper section 4.08; this is not a receipt against Solana escrow.
